description: Tremolo built around an LFO that can be locked to an external clock and multiplied from it, with the raw and shaped LFO brought out to jacks of their own

params.text: Sets the speed of the internal LFO, which is used when the Clock knob is set to int
Rounds and then flattens the LFO waveform, which deepens the tremolo as it goes up
Sets the asymmetry of the LFO: a symmetric triangle at centre, a rising sawtooth at one end and a falling one at the other
Sets how far the synchronised LFO lags the external clock, which is how the tremolo is placed on or off the beat
Shifts and scales the LFO before it modulates the audio, which deepens the tremolo as it goes up
Picks the clock: x1, x2, x3 and x4 lock the LFO to the signal at the ckin jack at that multiple of its rate, and int runs the internal LFO at the Rate knob's speed
Attenuates and inverts the CV at the jack beside it before it is added to the Shape knob
Attenuates and inverts the CV at the jack beside it before it is added to the Skew knob
Attenuates and inverts the CV at the jack beside it before it is added to the Phase knob
Attenuates and inverts the CV at the jack beside it before it is added to the Depth knob

inputs.text: The clock the LFO locks to when the Clock knob is set to a multiple
Shapes the LFO waveform through the trim knob beside it
Sets the LFO asymmetry through the trim knob beside it
Sets the phase against the external clock through the trim knob beside it
Sets the modulation depth through the trim knob beside it

outputs.text: The audio with the tremolo applied
The skewed sawtooth straight from the LFO, before the shaping
The LFO after shaping, which is the signal that modulates the audio

notes: with the Clock knob on x1, x2, x3 or x4 the LFO is driven from the signal at ckin, so it does not move until a clock is patched there; the int setting runs it from the Rate knob

inputs.1: high above 1.6V · stepped · one channel only
